metadata.title: Urban Casual Portrait with Scrawled Typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a man in casual urban attire leaning against a textured white wall, featuring aggressive, hand-scrawled typography and a distressed, charcoal-like border.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center looking away from the text
Typography balanced against the subject's lean and gaze
High-contrast lighting creating sharp shadows against the wall
Distressed border framing the clean photographic center

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, scaled from waist to head.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and gaze, which directs the viewer toward the negative space on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face, follows the gaze to the text on the left, then down the body to the hand details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the upper left to accommodate large-scale typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral off-white and light grey (background and shirt)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red (primary text) and black (secondary text and border)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Naturalistic skin tones and fabric colors against a high-key, bright background.

letterConstructionRules: Aggressive, scratchy strokes resembling crayon or dry marker
Varying baseline and cap-height for a jittery effect
Visible texture within the strokes showing 'paper' bleed
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Primary text in red scrawl paired with secondary text in black scrawl for hierarchy.
graphicDevices: Subtle color wash/gradient on the edges

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the raw, energetic feel of the original lettering

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a denim jacket over a grey hoodie, leaning against a white textured wall, looking to the side. Apply a rough, distressed black charcoal border around the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-scrawled text in the upper left negative space using a textured red brush for the main name and a black brush for the sub-title.

verificationChecks: Is the text texture consistent with a dry marker or crayon?
Does the subject's gaze lead toward the text?
Is the border sufficiently distressed and irregular?

adjustableVariables: Color of the primary scrawled text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Brand logos or specific jewelry details
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face
Check that the border looks like a physical medium (charcoal/ink)
Verify the lighting on the wall matches the lighting on the subject
Confirm the typography maintains a 'scratchy' texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Hand-Scrawled Typography + Distressed Border Frame
